title: 5GS mobility management via a satellite NG-RAN cell

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The user equipment that performs 5GS mobility management via satellite NG-RAN cells.

entities.name: Access and Mobility Management Function
entities.description: The network function that manages access and mobility for UEs, including support for satellite NG-RAN cells.

entities.name: NAS timer for satellite access
entities.description: Timer value applicable for NAS procedures when accessing via satellite NG-RAN cells, as specified in table 10.2.1 for UE and table 10.2.2 for AMF.

entities.name: Satellite access indication
entities.description: Condition indicating that access is via a satellite NG-RAN cell, provided by lower layers to the AMF.

entities.name: NAS procedure
entities.description: A non-access stratum procedure during which NAS timer values are calculated at start and remain unchanged until completion, restart, or abortion.

relations.description: UE applies the NAS timer value for satellite access at the start of a NAS procedure.
AMF calculates the NAS timer value for satellite access at the start of a NAS procedure.
AMF stores the satellite access indication provided by lower layers.
NAS timer value is calculated at the start of the NAS procedure and not re-calculated until the procedure ends.
AMF stores the satellite access indication when performing NAS signalling via satellite NG-RAN cells.
